context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about board transitions
purpose: Teach: 撤去/法定/スローガン/任期/速やか/命名/デフォルト/稼動

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君の任期が始まって半年か。前任の影は速やかに撤去したほうがいい。
lines.en: Half a year into your term already. You should clear away your predecessor's shadow swiftly.
lines.style: Calm elder statesman tone, measured pacing, slight gravitas with paternal warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、ただ法定の手続きが多くて、思うように動けないんですよ。
lines.en: Yes, but there are so many statutory procedures, I can't move as I'd like.
lines.style: Younger executive, slightly frustrated but respectful, professional Tokyo intonation throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 形式は形式だ。むしろ新しいスローガンを掲げる方が先だろう。
lines.en: Formalities are formalities. Hoisting a new slogan should come first, really.
lines.style: Wise, slightly dismissive of bureaucracy, voice carries the weight of long experience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実は新規事業の命名でも揉めていまして、デフォルトの社名案に逆戻りです。
lines.en: Honestly we're stuck on naming the new venture too — back to the default proposal.
lines.style: Confessional, slightly self-deprecating, lowered voice as if admitting a small defeat.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ははは、命名で揉めるうちが華だよ。工場はもうフル稼動しているのかね。
lines.en: Ha, squabbling over names is the fun part. Is the plant running at full capacity yet?
lines.style: Warm hearty laugh, then shifts to genuine curious inquiry, grandfatherly affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 稼動率は八割です。残りは私の決断待ちで、止まったままで。
lines.en: Operating rate is eighty percent. The rest waits on my decision, just stalled.
lines.style: Burdened, honest admission, voice trailing slightly at the end with hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 迷いは部下に伝染する。社長というのは、間違ってもいいから速やかに決めることだ。
lines.en: Hesitation infects your subordinates. A president must decide quickly, even wrongly.
lines.style: Firm avuncular advice, leaning forward in delivery, conviction earned from decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。任期の終わりに、胸を張れる仕事にしたいです。
lines.en: I'll take that to heart. By term's end, I want work I can be proud of.
lines.style: Resolved and grateful, slight bow felt in the voice, renewed determination.
